timeline.draft_answer: ETH+ is an ETH-wide initiative launched by the Executive Board to tap the breadth of expertise within the ETH community through a bottom-up tender. Researchers, departments, administrative units, and associations (such as VSETH and AVETH) submitted idea sketches — 68 by May 2018, involving all 16 academic departments — to identify areas of greatest potential for cross-disciplinary collaboration. Selected initiatives (e.g., the ETH Centre for the Fundamentals of Data Science led by Peter Bühlmann) are financed using ETH reserves, with contributions from the involved professorships/departments, the Executive Board, and third-party funds. A second call for idea sketches was planned for October. The evidence does not specify the full list of initiatives or the exact founding date.
